subject: SIG evidence: deploy approvals, CI/CD controls & secrets provenance
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@blueharbor.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.example.com
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@auditco.io>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG followup — SDLC artefacts for deploy approvals and secrets provenance

Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of the SIG assessment for FinServCo we need a short evidence bundle focused on a handful of items we flagged: deploy approval history (canary / prod rollouts), CI/CD control evidence (job configs, who can merge/run deploy pipelines), and secrets management provenance (vault usage, rotation cadence, and any ephemeral token snapshots).

Requested items (ideally in one package):
- A manifest listing the artefacts you will provide (PDF)
- Extract of change-approval logs for Jan–Mar 2027 (CSV)
- Short excerpts of CI job configs and PR gating rules (text)
- Statement on secret rotation policies and where ephemeral tokens are issued (short bullet list)

Could you confirm what you can deliver by EOD Tue, Apr 6? If anything requires a redaction step, call that out and we can accept a redacted CSV first. If helpful we can schedule a 30-min quick review with an assessor.

Claire Jensen
Senior Security Assessor — BlueHarbor Security
claire.jensen@blueharbor.com

---
Attachments: none in this message
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.example.com
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@blueharbor.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com, markus_klein@redwood.example.com, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@auditco.io>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG followup — SDLC artefacts for deploy approvals and secrets provenance

Claire — thanks for the concise list. We can provide the items you requested. Quick notes:

- Manifest: will produce a signed manifest PDF enumerating files and checksums.
- Change-approval extract: we will export a CSV of approvals (Jira change tickets + approver IDs) covering 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31.
- CI job configs: will include pipeline snippets for the deploy pipelines (names: deploy-canary, deploy-prod, promote-release).
- Secrets provenance: we will include an operations memo describing vault key rotation policy, ephemeral token TTLs, and KMS/HSM usage.

Monica and Markus — looping you in to confirm the CSV export and to attach the runbook excerpts.

We expect to send a package (attachments + Drive link) by Mon morning; if you need it earlier we can push a redacted CSV today.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Policy & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG followup — SDLC artefacts for deploy approvals and secrets provenance

Diego / Claire,

I've pulled the exports and pasted key excerpts below to speed the review. Full files are attached in my follow-up email (sdlc_evidence_manifest_20270405.pdf, ci_job_configs_excerpt.txt, change_approval_extract_202701-202703.csv).

Quick excerpts:
- PR gating: all PRs require 1 technical reviewer + 1 security reviewer for changes touching runtime/*.
- Merge allowance: only reviewers with role "svc-team-leads" or above (role map maintained in AD) can merge to main after CI success.
- Deploy pipelines: deploy-canary (auto-promote if smoke tests pass within 30m), deploy-prod (manual approval required; approval list pulled from group:prod-deployers).
- Secrets rotation: KMS root keys rotated annually; application-level vault tokens are short-lived (default TTL 8h) and rotated on redeploy.

Drive link to the evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSDLC-Evidence-Manifest

I will attach the CSV and runbook snippets to the next email.

Monica Patel
Security Operations — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG followup — SDLC artefacts for deploy approvals and secrets provenance

Thanks Monica — that excerpt is helpful. Two clarifying asks before we mark this item closed:

1) You mentioned ephemeral token TTL of 8h. Can you provide evidence of rotation or issuance events for ephemeral tokens (audit logs showing token mint events) for a sample week? A redacted log extract is fine.
2) For the change-approval extract: please include a column that maps approver to their role (e.g., engineer, team lead, security reviewer) so we can validate approver authority. If the CSV already contains an approver_id we can map on our side, but including role saves time.

If you can get those two items in the package today we can proceed. If a small call helps, I'm available 3:30–4:30pm PT.

Claire
